title: Network Coverage Optimization Engine
summary: Greedy algorithm for nationwide tower site placement using Gaussian-decay population scoring on a 121M-row building dataset. Supports configurable exclusion radii, region vs. thana scan modes, and BallTree spatial search. Improved placement effectiveness by ~20% over previous methodology.

title: Customer360 — Unified Telecom Data Platform
summary: End-to-end data platform integrating 18 data sources across Hadoop, Oracle, and PySpark for 50M+ users. Delivers 300+ daily KPIs for campaigns, analytics, and AI use cases. Fully orchestrated on Airflow.

title: VOC Response Automation (LLM + Embeddings)
summary: LLM-based pipeline using semantic embeddings to automate Voice of Customer responses at 80% accuracy. Processes 3K+ daily feedbacks and reduced response time from 72 hours to 1 day. Cost-optimised by using embeddings over generative LLMs for routing.

title: Thana-Level Urbanization Scoring System
summary: Cluster-based urbanization scoring for Bangladesh using a large building dataset. Engineered features include density, height profile, land use, and contiguity — clustered into Rural/Urban/Metro-Core tiers with revenue correlation analysis.

title: GenAI BI Assistant (Axiata AWS Hackathon)
summary: Natural-language to SQL analytics system built on AWS Bedrock. Turns business questions into SQL queries, executes on live data, and returns narrative summaries. Built with Claude 3 Sonnet, Titan Embeddings V2, FAISS, and LangChain. Presented at Axiata AWS GenAI Hackathon.

title: Datathon 2.0 — Official Website
summary: Built and launched the official website for Datathon 2.0, the largest data competition in Bangladesh. Delivered 5K+ registrations.
